title: Door closer
object: Overhead hydraulic door closer, rack and pinion, EN 1154 size 3, in plan section
idea: Debounce: act only once the input has stopped for long enough
summary: A spring drives the piston back and the oil can only leave through two needle valves, so the door shuts at a pace set by the orifice equation. Every push reopens the door and starts the whole closing again; it latches only after a quiet spell as long as the closing time from where it was left.
usedFor: Software-concept explainer: debounce and restartable timers drawn as hardware
Hydraulics teaching: orifice flow, check valves, rack-and-pinion conversion
Product documentation for door closers and their sweep and latch adjustment
controls: Space or click the closer pushes the door · drag the door in plan E · R shuts it · S slow motion
